description: Type subscriptions.create/patch's HTTP 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT for a BigQuery subscription whose writer service account Pub/Sub cannot use yet ('You have passed an invalid argument to the service (argument=BigQueryConfig::service_account_email).'). A just-created service account is rejected this way for a few seconds while it propagates; the generic BadRequest forced callers to match on the message.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Pub/Sub cannot use the BigQuery config's service account (HTTP 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT). Retryable while a just-created service account propagates.
